items.title: Ironically, the Blue Wave Could Make Hyperscalers “Good Businesses Again” by Forcing Capex Discipline
items.summary: Key TakeawaysDemocrats won control of the House and Senate in Tuesday’s midterms, and state results point to more limits on building data centers but fewer outright bans. Tighter rules that slow the build-out would help Amazon, Alphabet, Meta and Microsoft shareholders, because less capex while capacity stays scarce repairs free cash flow without hurting demand.
